name: diy-walking-challenges-image-worker
description: Self-hostable Cloudflare Workers AI service for optional DIY Walking Challenges artwork generation

scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate && npm run deploy:worker

RATE_LIMIT_HASH_PEPPER.description: Private rate-limit code. Generate a new random value of at least 32 characters; never share or commit it.

REPORT_TOKEN_SECRET.description: A second, different private code used to verify image reports. Generate a new random value of at least 32 characters.

DAILY_GLOBAL_NEURON_BUDGET.description: The Worker's conservative daily image-generation budget. The reviewed 10000 default matches Cloudflare's currently documented free daily Workers AI allocation; limits can change.

ENFORCE_INSTALLATION_DAILY_CAPS.description: Keep false for an uncapped private server. Set true only to enforce six attempts per app installation and one per specific artwork slot per UTC day. The global Neuron guard remains active either way.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Leave blank for Android-only use. This is not an authentication setting.

ENABLED_MODELS.description: Keep `flux2-klein-4b,flux-schnell` for the two reviewed, inexpensive image models.

SAFETY_MODEL.description: Keep `@cf/meta/llama-guard-3-8b`; the Worker uses it to screen each artwork description before image generation.
